rationale: Mobilinx Hurontario General Partnership is the ProjectCo and 2019 is the correct initial investment year. Webuild directly reports 53.85% at June 30, 2026, but public evidence does not establish the legal date or mechanism removing JLIL's former 35%, the current Hitachi Rail, Amico and Transdev percentages, or whether the contemplated Equitix/Pantheon JLIL investment legally closed. A current ownership mutation is therefore deferred.

evidence.purpose: Confirms Webuild-group vehicles held 53.85% of the ProjectCo at June 30, 2026.
Confirms ProjectCo identity, the 2019 financial close and original consortium roles.
Supports the original six-sponsor cap table while not resolving the current residual stakes.
Confirms the 2026 contract restructuring rather than a disclosed equity sale.
